newsitem.title: GERMANY: Allianz sees cost pressure in industrial business.
newsitem.headline: Allianz sees cost pressure in industrial business.

text.p: Insurer Allianz AG Holding, which has declared its aim of becoming the world leader in industrial insurance, said on Thursday that cost pressures in the segment were rising.

Manfred Illner, board member at Allianz's domestic non-life unit Allianz Versicherungs AG, told a conference that premium income from industrial business would continue to fall as clients demanded alternative forms of cover.
"The pressure to make profit from industrial business will rise," Illner said.
The greatest potential for cost cutting lay in shedding staff, Illner said, although he cautioned that this was a limited possibility.
At the same time, more money had to be spent to correct "major weaknesses" in research and development.
Industrial business was heading for a period of decisive change as customers demanded more individual solutions to their risk cover problems, Illner said.
In the medium term, the concept of individual fire insurance cover for large industrial groups would decline, he said.
